For personal and spiritual growth, please practice the entire flow:
You are not your body. You are not your mind.
This 30-minute yoga class is designed to help you experience this truth, not just understand it intellectually. Through breath, movement, and stillness, you will begin to create a beautiful distance from the noise of the mind and the fluctuations of the body, and touch something far deeper within yourself.
This is what yoga was always meant to be: a path to your own higher self. 🏾
